source: Dragon Lake Parking dataset, Shen, Pan, Govindarajan, Borrelli (UC Berkeley), CC0, https://zenodo.org/records/10084683

semantic_channels.0: drivable = 0.5 on the aisles area, -1 elsewhere
semantic_channels.1: road_divider: -1 everywhere (none in a parking lot)

approximations: Derived from the CC0 recordings only, not from the GPL-3 toolkit map: the drivable area is where vehicles were seen, so parts of the lot outside the drone's view (fov_*_per_recording) or never driven or parked in during the recordings listed in built_from are missing.
Moving-vehicle centre traces (speed >= 0.3 m/s) drawn 2.0 m wide; parked footprints are DLP obstacles plus vehicle agents stopped >= 30 s; enclosed holes <= 40.0 m2 filled.
aisles variant: stall bands = parked footprints grown to 5.2 x 2.6 m and closed with a 1.5 m disk; rows with no parked car in any recording stay drivable.
world_* describe a 4:3 dashboard view around mapped_area_m, not the lot itself (lot_m).
_comment: fov_x_m is the drone's x-range estimated as the extent of all agent positions (union over built_from); the drone was not in the same place for every recording, so the per-recording ranges differ and are what censoring uses. Tracks that start or end within 5 m of their recording's range were cut off by the camera, not real entries/exits; see the per-agent censored_start / censored_end flags in data/dlp/<recording>.meta.json.
